entries.original: Added `sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces` so sandboxed commands on Linux can create user namespaces (Chromium, rootless podman); this lets them get around the sandbox's file protections
entries.translated: Linux의 샌드박스 명령어가 사용자 네임스페이스(Chromium, rootless podman)를 생성하여 샌드박스의 파일 보호 기능을 우회할 수 있도록 `sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces` 추가

entries.original: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS` so unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) notices a usage limit that was lifted before its reset
entries.translated: 무인 재시도 모드(`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`)가 초기화 전 해제된 사용량 제한을 감지할 수 있도록 `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS` 추가

entries.original: Fixed every request failing on Vertex, Bedrock and other providers when the endpoint or a gateway rejects tool search, and behind gateways with ToolSearch disallowed or left out of `--tools` (a 2.1.304 regression): Claude Code now retries without it
entries.translated: 엔드포인트나 게이트웨이가 도구 검색을 거부하거나 ToolSearch가 비활성화된 환경에서 Vertex, Bedrock 등의 요청이 실패하던 문제(2.1.304 회귀 버그) 수정 (이제 도구 검색 없이 재시도)

entries.original: Fixed `/effort` and `/autocompact` settings not applying when the model name differed from a `modelOverrides` value by letter case or a `[1m]` tag
entries.translated: 모델 이름의 대소문자나 `[1m]` 태그 차이로 인해 `modelOverrides` 설정이 `/effort` 및 `/autocompact`에 적용되지 않던 문제 수정

entries.original: Fixed new worktrees in a bare repository sometimes starting from local HEAD instead of the default branch, and unchanged subagent worktrees sometimes not being cleaned up
entries.translated: bare 저장소의 새 worktree가 기본 브랜치 대신 로컬 HEAD에서 시작되거나, 변경 없는 하위 에이전트 worktree가 정리되지 않던 문제 수정

entries.original: Fixed Bash commands on a full disk failing with a raw `ENOSPC` file path: the error now says the disk is full and that nothing ran
entries.translated: 디스크 용량 부족 시 Bash 명령어가 `ENOSPC` 오류로 실패하던 문제 수정 (이제 디스크가 가득 찼으며 실행된 것이 없음을 알림)

entries.original: Fixed an MCP server passed by a cloud session or by the SDK's `setMcpServers` being replaced later in the session by a same-named server from your own settings
entries.translated: 클라우드 세션이나 SDK의 `setMcpServers`를 통해 전달된 MCP 서버가 사용자 설정의 동일한 이름의 서버로 교체되던 문제 수정

entries.original: Fixed Claude naming the wrong model for a subagent's work after the subagent switched to a fallback model
entries.translated: 하위 에이전트가 폴백 모델로 전환한 후 잘못된 모델 이름이 표시되던 문제 수정

entries.original: Fixed cloud sessions and teammates not telling Claude when a compaction had to leave the oldest messages out of its summary to fit
entries.translated: 압축 시 오래된 메시지가 요약에서 제외될 때 클라우드 세션 및 팀원 기능이 Claude에게 이를 알리지 않던 문제 수정

entries.original: Fixed more cases of scheduled Cowork cloud sessions waiting five minutes for each subagent whose WebFetch needed a URL approval that nobody was there to give
entries.translated: 예약된 Cowork 클라우드 세션에서 승인할 사람이 없는 WebFetch URL 승인 대기로 인해 하위 에이전트가 5분씩 대기하던 문제 추가 수정

entries.original: Fixed Workflow resume re-running already-completed `pipeline()` and `parallel()` agents instead of serving them from the run's journal
entries.translated: 워크플로 재개 시 이미 완료된 `pipeline()` 및 `parallel()` 에이전트를 저널에서 가져오지 않고 재실행하던 문제 수정

entries.original: Fixed Remote Control leaving empty "(session)" entries in `/resume` after switching conversations with `/resume`
entries.translated: `/resume`으로 대화 전환 후 Remote Control이 빈 "(session)" 항목을 남기던 문제 수정

entries.original: Fixed `/usage` rows being cut off in narrow terminals
entries.translated: 좁은 터미널에서 `/usage` 행이 잘리던 문제 수정

entries.original: Fixed startup warnings printing as raw text above the logo: they now go to the debug log, and permission rules that restrict nothing show as warning rows under the banner
entries.translated: 시작 경고가 로고 위에 텍스트로 출력되던 문제 수정 (이제 디버그 로그로 기록되며, 제한 사항이 없는 권한 규칙은 배너 아래 경고 행으로 표시)

entries.original: Fixed screen reader mode: search boxes now say "Search:" instead of a symbol VoiceOver read as "telephone recorder", and highlighted prompt text, such as Ctrl+R search matches and "ultrathink", no longer has spaces inside words
entries.translated: 스크린 리더 모드 수정: 검색창에서 VoiceOver가 "전화 녹음기"로 읽던 기호 대신 "Search:"라고 안내하도록 변경하고, Ctrl+R 검색 결과나 "ultrathink" 등 강조된 텍스트의 단어 내 공백 제거

entries.original: Self-hosted runner: Fixed a start script that shares only its stdout with the runner or orchestrator failing with `Resource temporarily unavailable` when `TERM` is set (a 2.1.300 regression)
entries.translated: 셀프 호스트 러너: `TERM` 설정 시 표준 출력만

entries.original: Self-hosted runner: Fixed repository access failing since 2.1.296 when a git credential helper or askpass program reads its settings through `GIT_CONFIG`
entries.translated: Self-hosted runner: Fixed repository access failing since 2.1.296 when a git credential helper or askpass program reads its settings through `GIT_CONFIG`

entries.original: Self-hosted runner: Fixed the orchestrator reporting a spawn-runner hook as timed out when a runner it started in the background kept its output open
entries.translated: Self-hosted runner: Fixed the orchestrator reporting a spawn-runner hook as timed out when a runner it started in the background kept its output open

entries.original: Improved `/usage`: each warning is now a one-line fix that names its source, and `f` applies the fixes; the same fixes appear in VS Code and `/doctor`
entries.translated: Improved `/usage`: each warning is now a one-line fix that names its source, and `f` applies the fixes; the same fixes appear in VS Code and `/doctor`

entries.original: Improved MCP consent dialogs so an Enter meant for the prompt is less likely to be taken as Accept
entries.translated: Improved MCP consent dialogs so an Enter meant for the prompt is less likely to be taken as Accept

entries.original: Improved a mod's `Image` to draw its picture in iTerm2 3.5 and later with fullscreen rendering, where it showed only its `alt` text
entries.translated: Improved a mod's `Image` to draw its picture in iTerm2 3.5 and later with fullscreen rendering, where it showed only its `alt` text

entries.original: Remote Control: Improved the spawn-mode messages: pressing `w` now says the new mode is saved for the folder, and a later `claude remote-control` start that uses the saved mode says where it came from
entries.translated: Remote Control: Improved the spawn-mode messages: pressing `w` now says the new mode is saved for the folder, and a later `claude remote-control` start that uses the saved mode says where it came from

entries.original: Changed `allowedMcpServers` to stop filtering `managed-mcp.json` stdio servers that use `${VAR}` only in `env`: one your allowlist left out now loads on upgrade; use `deniedMcpServers` to keep it off
entries.translated: Changed `allowedMcpServers` to stop filtering `managed-mcp.json` stdio servers that use `${VAR}` only in `env`: one your allowlist left out now loads on upgrade; use `deniedMcpServers` to keep it off

entries.original: Changed plugins that Claude Desktop mounts by path to no longer keep their `allowed-tools` when your organization's managed settings set `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`
entries.translated: Changed plugins that Claude Desktop mounts by path to no longer keep their `allowed-tools` when your organization's managed settings set `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`

entries.original: Changed the `/artifacts` delete confirmation to take 1 or Enter to keep, 2 to delete, and Esc to cancel; `y` and `n` no longer answer it
entries.translated: Changed the `/artifacts` delete confirmation to take 1 or Enter to keep, 2 to delete, and Esc to cancel; `y` and `n` no longer answer it

entries.original: Changed a mod's docked pane to stay within 45% of the terminal's width, including a width kept from a wider terminal
entries.translated: Changed a mod's docked pane to stay within 45% of the terminal's width, including a width kept from a wider terminal

entries.original: [VSCode] Added a "Running start-up hooks" spinner status, with a screen reader announcement, while SessionStart or Setup hooks run
entries.translated: [VSCode] Added a "Running start-up hooks" spinner status, with a screen reader announcement, while SessionStart or Setup hooks run

entries.original: [VSCode] Fixed the spinner cutting off "Compacting..." when your `spinnerVerbs` setting replaces the built-in verbs with short ones
entries.translated: [VSCode] Fixed the spinner cutting off "Compacting..." when your `spinnerVerbs` setting replaces the built-in verbs with short ones

entries.original: [VSCode] Changed the message shown when a session does not start in time and no hook is running: it now leads with the output logs and lists causes instead of pointing to sign-in and network first
entries.translated: [VSCode] Changed the message shown when a session does not start in time and no hook is running: it now leads with the output logs and lists causes instead of pointing to sign-in and network first

entries.original: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the Cloud environments admin page wrongly refusing to save an existing environment with an "installs packages" error
entries.translated: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the Cloud environments admin page wrongly refusing to save an existing environment with an "installs packages" error

entries.original: [Cloud sessions] Improved deleting a self-hosted environment so the dialog and error messages say what blocks the delete and what it will affect
entries.translated: [Cloud sessions] Improved deleting a self-hosted environment so the dialog and error messages say what blocks the delete and what it will affect

entries.original: [Claude Tag] Added public Slack channels Claude hasn't joined to the Claude Tag admin Add place search, so admins can set one up from there
entries.translated: [Claude Tag] Added public Slack channels Claude hasn't joined to the Claude Tag admin Add place search, so admins can set one up from there

entries.original: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag access bundles so a repository that moved to another GitHub account can be added again
entries.translated: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag access bundles so a repository that moved to another GitHub account can be added again

entries.original: [Claude Tag] Fixed a routine set up in a Slack DM thread no longer posting after another routine in that thread restarted the conversation; both now keep posting there
entries.translated: [Claude Tag] Fixed a routine set up in a Slack DM thread no longer posting after another routine in that thread restarted the conversation; both now keep posting there

entries.original: [Claude Tag] Fixed routines set up in a Slack thread reporting success without posting after the conversation ended; those runs are now skipped and the creator is told
entries.translated: [Claude Tag] Fixed routines set up in a Slack thread reporting success without posting after the conversation ended; those runs are now skipped and the creator is told

entries.original: [Claude Tag] Improved Claude Tag admin pages in large organizations so plugin, skill and bundle edits work while the channel list is still loading
entries.translated: [Claude Tag] Improved Claude Tag admin pages in large organizations so plugin, skill and bundle edits work while the channel list is still loading

entries.original: [Code Review] Fixed Code Review sometimes not reviewing the newest commit when several pushes landed on a pull request during a review
entries.translated: [Code Review] Fixed Code Review sometimes not reviewing the newest commit when several pushes landed on a pull request during a review

entries.original: [Code Review] Changed Code Review re-reviews so they no longer open with LGTM while earlier blocking findings are still open
entries.translated: [Code Review] Changed Code Review re-reviews so they no longer open with LGTM while earlier blocking findings are still open
